{{Quote|Not the most brilliant bunch of plant-heads in the galaxy, but certainly the most trigger-happy. Saw a whole squad of them take out a speeder taxi once because they thought it moved suspiciously &hellip;|[[Roark Slader]]|<ref name="PA" />}}
'''Protectorate''' was a part of the [[Order]] branch of the [[Pentastar Alignment]]. Protectorate took on the duties of the [[Ubiqtorate/Legends|Ubiqtorate's]] [[Internal Security Branch]] and the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Imperial Guard Corps]]. Their main concern was the protection of Alignment personnel and equipment. Protectorate drew their recruits mainly from former [[CompForce/Legends|CompForce]] units rather than standard [[Imperial Army/Legends|Army]] or [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] troops. The training methods and operational procedures were kept secret. Protectorate agents were graded by number from "10" for the most general of troops to "1" which designated elite [[Guardian (Protectorate)|Guardians]] who protected members of the [[Chamber of Order]]. Command officers received the designation of "0."
